decisions.reason: A dedicated page and clear fit with the sensing line indicate the option is being actively kept open at low cost while its market value remains promising.
As a replacement for an established voltage measurement module, this product has low uncertainty and is a core part of the platform, so it is kept.
A software proxy for MQTT communication has low keeping costs and a dedicated page, making it a valuable connectivity option to keep open.
Only being mentioned on the website after a year suggests weak demand and unresolved uncertainty, so the option is unlikely to justify further commitment and should be abandoned.
Its own page and alignment with environmental sensing suggest the CO2 sensor option remains promising and cheap to keep open.
The touch panel accessory has a dedicated page and, while somewhat niche, its keeping costs are likely low enough to retain as a real option.
